subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): let plugins open Gateway-managed realtime voice sessions

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose a trusted Gateway-dispatch Plugin SDK API that lets plugins select an agent session and receive raw realtime Talk audio?
rationale: This is a new privileged public Plugin SDK surface, so code review alone cannot decide the intended extension boundary, supported caller class, or compatibility commitment.

options.title: Approve a narrow trusted SDK contract
options.body: Keep `runtime.talk.openSession` after the parent is resolved, document its trusted-only scope and PCM/session semantics, and add focused compatibility coverage.

options.title: Keep voice ownership outside core
options.body: Direct avatar-style integrations to an external plugin or a narrower existing surface until maintainers choose a broader realtime API direction.

options.title: Redesign around a narrower capability
options.body: Require a reduced event or command contract if raw PCM and arbitrary session selection are broader than the intended plugin privilege model.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow trusted SDK contract
recommendation.body: Keep `runtime.talk.openSession` after the parent is resolved, document its trusted-only scope and PCM/session semantics, and add focused compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed contributor across the related Talk API proposals and can clarify the intended contract while an owner decides product direction.
